name: Yandere Rays Darling Show
original_name: ヤンデレイズダーリンショー
source:
One day, Yamiru Fujibana, a very strange adult woman, decides to go out with her childhood friend Kiiro, a boy she has a crush on. Will they be able to have a safe day, or....?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/8439]NovelGame[/url]]
